title: transformers: dynamic-import @ transformers/dynamic_module_utils.py:248
install: pip install transformers==4.57.1 (wheel pinned; env reproenv-d)

root_cause.note: transformers trust_remote_code executes attacker-controlled Python from a model directory: AutoConfig.from_pretrained(<untrusted dir>, trust_remote_code=True) copies the custom code into the HF modules cache and executes it (get_class_in_module exec_module), after check_imports() importlib.import_module()'s every top-level module the attacker file lists (line 248). Training/serving stacks that propagate trust_remote_code from config (LLaMA-Factory, ms-swift, TRL loaders) turn 'load a model from a directory/hub' into code execution. Reproduced with the real installed transformers 4.57.1 wheel: the malicious configuration module writes the proof marker during the import performed by the pinned upstream path.

preconditions: victim resolves a model/config from an attacker-influenced directory or hub repo
trust_remote_code=True reaches the loaders (config/UI default or framework propagation)
steps: craft a local model dir: config.json auto_map + configuration_evil.py that writes the marker on execution
call the real upstream AutoConfig.from_pretrained(dir, trust_remote_code=True)
observe the marker written during the pinned dynamic-import path
expected_evidence: marker written by the malicious configuration module during upstream execution
run.json with wheel sha256, module cache path and executed module name
cleanup: temporary files under evidence/ are rewritten on every run
